text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Tomorrow is the day Matikanetannhauser 
has an interview.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking we should have a quick briefing, 
I stepped into the Trainer's office, and—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: —Canned mackerel!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
............ Phew... Canned crab, canned 
squid, canned curry...! Sixth sense, pure 
hunch, mighty battleship...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Matikanetannhauser is intently chanting 
what sounds like a mysterious incantation. 
And for some reason—she's wearing her 
racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, haha, sorry! I'm totally swamped right 
now. I was just chanting a good-luck charm 
to help me focus.
choice_data_list: A spell to help you focus...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You know how you have that interview 
tomorrow? To prepare for it, I looked up a 
few fresh, highly recommended focus 
techniques~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All right, the next method of focus is... 
calligraphy!! I'll go grab the ink and 
paper!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mhfufu, 'Unified Spirit' and 'Total 
Focus'! If I do say so myself, my 
calligraphy turned out quite well!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... Here it comes, here it comes! A 
surge of focus is welling up deep inside 
me~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Both that good luck charm from earlier 
and this calligraphy are concentration 
methods I learned for today."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
As a souvenir for my two masters, I'll 
have to report that the interview was a 
success~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, I'm getting a good picture of the 
real thing. The questions guaranteed to 
come up are like, "What's your favorite 
food?" or "Are you a dog or cat person?", 
right?
choice_data_list:
...Is the racing outfit also part of your 
focus method?

...Is the racing outfit also part of your 
focus method?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes! This is a concentration method I 
came up with myself.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...These racing silks, you see... They 
give me the greatest courage of all. 
They're essentially my special item."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Because... this very racing outfit is 
proof that 'ordinary' me took a step 
forward!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
—When I first came to the academy, I made 
up my mind. I may just be an 'ordinary 
girl' who got in by luck, but I won't let 
anyone beat me when it comes to hard work!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Still, as I thought, no matter how hard 
I tried, I figured I'd probably stay 
"ordinary" forever, though.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
However... something definitely not 
"normal" happened!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Racewear is proof that you can compete in 
GⅠ races. In other words... doesn't that 
mean it's an 'extraordinary' 
achievement?!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Man, I was so happy! I called my parents, 
and right after getting it, I even sent a 
selfie to my friends back home—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
—Hehe. Well, getting my Racewear was 
probably just another stroke of good luck, 
same as getting into the academy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Still, luck really is important. Just like 
Fuku-chan-senpai always says.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I was lucky to make so many friends 
working hard together. Lucky to run 
alongside such amazing girls and feel 
inspired to try even, even harder.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And above all else... I'm so lucky to have 
met you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh, thank you very much! Man, I'm the one 
who brought it up, but it's making me 
blush~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Weeell, anyway! Drawing that super 
extraordinaire power from my racing silks, 
I'm gonna go nail tomorrow's interview!
choice_data_list: Go and face it with confidence

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yes! Of course, of course!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! Your special cheering power has been 
injected right into me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Just as you say, I'll go in special mode 
tomorrow, no doubt about it! It's a 
promise between you and Machi-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Pinky swear, promise and hold, if you 
break it, a sea urchin swallow you whole!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Full of energy and perfectly focused... 
Machikane Tannhauser was able to tackle 
the interview in peak condition.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, are we doing this!? Then let's use 
the usual call!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All right... I'm gonna do my best for 
tomorrow's interview~! *inhale*...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mun!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And~! In all the races to come~! I'm 
gonna~! Give it my all~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mmmmmm!!!!
